notes.title: Check out our Broadcast of Sit-Back Attack!
notes.content:
Heyo!

There is a special LIMITED Steam achievement at the END of the Demo!

We have a broadcast up for people that want to watch how the game plays in real-time!
Come check it out!

Also we want to take the time to thank any and all that are participating in the support of Sit-Back Attack!
It is most appreciated!

Stapleton is continuing his relentless onslaught of game development and bug squashing.
What he is currently working on:

1. Fixing a couple visual bugs.
2. Adding a dialogue box (thank you to the community)
3. Making pets stronger. Their attacks are weaker than intended.
4. Fixing a bug with Crit Multipliers
5. Adding a couple other QOL changes.
6. Much more, but for now, these are the most recent things he will patch up.

Thank you!

DPSII Team

notes.title: Steam Next Fest & BIG upgrades! Limited time DEMO! Sit-Back Attack!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, Stapleton here.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45352751/04caecc1482caadeb8c44702ff01778620249261.gif

Sit-Back Attack has come a long way since we first released our demo a month ago!
Last night, we uploaded a large patch to the DEMO that added:

 Level cap increase to 75
 Opened up the ocean region
 More characters to play!
 More information!
 Added 1 of the 4 pets!
 A mini-boss to beat at the end of the Demo
 Some achievements used to level up your Pet
 One Steam Achievement to score a Perfect Game on your record for the Demo!
 Bug Fixes
 And a whole lot more!


If you haven't played the demo recently or AT ALL.
You gotta download it and give it a try! It's fun!

Don't forget to wishlist and follow! It is what keeps us plugging along!
As always all your support is wonderful and we will continue to develop this game that we think will bring you all a lot of enjoyment!

notes.title: BIG UPDATES for the Demo! The DEMO ENDS February 11th! Try it out Now!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Thank you all for your support and interest in Sit-Back Attack!
Since I have first released the Demo on Monday, it has made substantial progress!

There is only 3 more days to try the Demo before it gets taken down for some time!
So don't forget to try it out!

To those that haven't tried it out recently here are the changes made in the past 5 days:

- Dark Mage is been added to the Demo
- Enhancements now function properly
- Inn and Shop restock after completion of any level
- Numerous tooltips have been finished and are in
- Right click on equipment in the character or equipment screen to access the forge!
- All characters passive skills have been added in
- Elemental thorns akin to the Ice Guard are fully functional and deal damage based on the characters Deception.
- Same goes with Enspells, like Endark that deals damage every time a character hits an enemy.
- Numerous bugs have been demolished
- Any KNOWN crash has been squashed
- Currently no crashes exist (knock on wood)

The Dark Mage can be found as the last battle of Cave (Easy Level).

Continued support is always appreciated and ANY and ALL feedback is welcome!
Don't forget to try the Demo out before it comes DOWN on the 11th!

Thanks
- Stapleton!

notes.title: Sit-Back Attack DEMO is out! Idler Fest Time!!
notes.content:
Welcome EVERYONE! 
My name is Stapleton.
I am the Developer for Sit-Back Attack!

Yesterday, we launched the Demo to this here game.
Interested?
Then you should check it out!

It contains about roughly 2 - 3 hours of playtime depending on how fast you blow through.
Demo Features: 
- 10 or so characters to unlock!
- 100+ skills!
- 100+ monsters!
- Roughly 35% of the story
- Crafting!
- Unfortunately we had to put a level cap in of 60. The full game will have a level cap of over 500+

Enough reading me ramble!
Go try it out, it's a small download and doesn't require you to log in or be online or any other dumb **** like that!
QUICK AND EASY (hopefully lol). How games should be! 

Tell us or me or whomever what you think!
- Stapleton
